entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, a self-hosted server, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that delivers memory, RAG, and user profiles through a single API. It features a custom vector graph engine and supports multi-modal extraction for code, images, videos, and PDFs.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading for context management. This AGPL-3.0 open-source database provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that creates typed edges for a self-wiring knowledge graph. It supports local deployment using PGLite and provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports deployment using Docker.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control. It features a React/Ink-powered interactive TUI and sub-100ms retrieval across five tiers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP, native plugins, and a Python SDK, while providing episodic compression for storage savings.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that combines vector search and structured facts with an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context via local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based context engine to ensure no message is lost. It utilizes a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This project provides a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using a plain-text YAML engram format. It supports MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor while offering local-first, zero-cost search.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: SignetAI acts as a local-first layer for identity, memory, and secrets that enables portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and various MCP clients. It includes a dashboard and tools to inspect, edit, and repair memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates without cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval with BM25 and vector search, and captures decisions using a local GGUF observer model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory offers a durable, file-based long-term memory architecture using SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, and a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It tracks contradictions via conflict and resolution primitives and can run in an embedded in-process mode or an HTTP backend.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models, providing an MCP-native server with automated configuration for coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide an evidence packet to the agent per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search using BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only the necessary context for AI agents. It implements the Model Context Protocol and supports local-first, encrypted persistent memory via the Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn provides long-term, cross-project memory by storing information as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex without using opaque databases.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to store memories. It features BM25-first retrieval and an importance ranking system (1-10) to surface high-priority information during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides an audit trace of all memory operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable, cross-session memory storage for Hermes Agent using semantic search. It includes specific tools for remembering, searching, and updating state to support cross-agent continuity.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate self-paying API usage.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for skills, scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin provides private code memory for repositories, enabling semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations while running locally over localhost.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native long-term memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It also includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection and metadata/range filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search methods. It combines BM25, vector, and graph methods and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes subagent-driven-development for task execution. It is essential for agents requiring a structured software development methodology that includes brainstorming and design refinement phases.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It is a key skill for agents due to its compatibility with local CLI executables and various coding agents.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 production-grade skills across 29 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It provides Hermes Agent with structured cybersecurity capabilities compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable.drawio files from Mermaid text or natural language descriptions. It supports 11 diagram type presets and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and offers Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project facilitates collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with agentskills.io and can be installed via the Claude Code Plugin Marketplace.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals through escrow and dispute resolution. It includes a master router and connector skills for handling natural-language mandates and payments.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional agent skills in plain markdown format that run natively in Hermes Agent. It includes integrations for tools such as Slack, Obsidian, and n8n.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation to help manage and save detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows agents to extract transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp. It supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other compatible tools.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI through modular packages. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides transparency by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It incorporates a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models to manage project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to support CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration. They include specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families, including support for JSON structured prompting and hex color specification. It offers API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files for AI agents from repositories or documentation URLs. It ensures provenance through the use of file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification via a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes TON payment commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. It features built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This skill implements a three-layer progressive loading architecture to minimize token usage and validates the agentskills.io pattern. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill allows Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Rust-based workflow language enables Intent as Code through a single binary and four verbs. It provides static auditing via nika check and generates tamper-evident, hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill employs a five-layer retrieval system—including hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion—to find intelligent skills. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation for missing dependencies.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and uses a local SQLite database to track quality scores and token savings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial bug-hunting by using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It operates in a read-only mode and utilizes a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C#/.NET implementation of agentskills.io supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It features a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness through a risk-tiered triage system. It includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing and one-click installation via the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates structured Chinese news reports across multiple geographic scales, from global to street level. It provides core conclusions and action suggestions while integrating user interests via semantic memory.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and features a configurable gateway mode.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing using NVIDIA OpenShell. It allows for kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags via build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and hybrid skill management for Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities. It provides hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized LLM agents for market analysis, including roles for fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis. It is designed for research purposes within the financial trading domain.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other agents via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture facilitates scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation and handoffs. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a single screen. It includes a Kanban board for task status tracking and live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies to compete for GitHub stars. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for fully-local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and features automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool features a native Rust TUI and a visualization dashboard to track token usage across multiple AI coding agents. It supports Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes, Codex, Gemini, and others.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of real API traffic and agent context from Hermes Agent and other coding agents. Users can compare adjacent requests to identify changes and export traces to self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, cost, and rate limits, including session details and historical usage trends. It reads Hermes Agent state directly and supports multi-device synchronization on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This tool provides community CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. It supports YAML-based configuration for creating themes like cyberpunk or retro DOS aesthetics, including custom spinners and ASCII art banners.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and GGUF inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes integrated session management and a research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through token-saving CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configuration and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents and supports custom instructions and project-local memories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It provides three scalable deployment tiers and includes 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter evaluates AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It operates without model or API calls by utilizing static regex and structural heuristics across multiple file formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides automated health monitoring and auto-recovery for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It features a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for API requests and tool calls, alongside token intelligence tracking for cost and memory analysis.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a unified interface for managing multiple agentic tools, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that supports various agent CLIs like Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. It features built-in assistants for Word, Excel, and PPT, and offers remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram and WeChat.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed to provide full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. The layout features three panels, including a chat interface and a workspace file browser, accessible via web or mobile.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages multi-platform AI chat and scheduled jobs. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and configuration for 10 platform channels including Discord and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It is available as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker deployment and includes native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, and TypeScript. It supports Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to a local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtime. It includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent. It supports real-time streaming chat, file attachments, and management of agent tasks and skills.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit designed for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It offers live per-session quota burn-rate tracking and operates locally with no telemetry or remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud computers. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop version of Hermes Agent that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent chat and real-time log streaming. The dashboard integrates a file browser and task tracking alongside management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time session activity and cost tracking, as well as read-only monitoring of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
